scripts.build: tsc -p packages/shared/tsconfig.build.json && cd apps/web && node node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js build
scripts.lint: eslint apps/web/src apps/web/vite.config.ts packages/shared/src playwright.config.ts tests/e2e scripts/run-e2e.mjs scripts/run-performance.mjs
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/shared/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.tools.json --noEmit
